author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: This sounds like a neat feature. This could also help me better know which of my friends are also friends with each other. I often don't invite certain friends at the same time out of respect for them since many of them have severe social anxiety like myself and I want to avoid putting them in an uncomfortable situation.
Notes are good for this right now.
Can't tell you how many times I've been in a situation where I'm like "you know this person too??"
Oh I got a new who was talking with my regular friends, and this new friend introduced me to her lol, funny though,but that would nice niche feature.

I want this feature, even knowing people in the VRC clubbing scene would just use it to cancel each other, "oh you're friends with this person I don't like? blocked" etc. I think overall it'd be worth adding though. Add an opt-out toggle though, please.

My concern is that the feature request, as currently written, does not consider the right to privacy of the mutual friends at all. If implemented as a mandatory feature, it risks importing the same bullying behaviours we already see on social media and Discord. (The 'guilt by association' drama and 'friend of my enemy' ultimatum bs)

I mean, does anyone really want their best friend to be able to see that they're still 'friends' with said friend's ex?

VRChat doesn’t need to inherit these problems. If this feature must be implemented, it should only ever be opt-in visibility with a bias toward strong privacy controls, rather than arbitrarily forced on all users.

details: One of the biggest problems I have as an extrovert is getting my introverted friends introduced to other people. One thing that would help is this: Open friends list, click on your friend and click a button that says something like "Tag Mutual Friends". From that point on, I'd know who me and that friend mutually know, but then I can easily deduce who they DON'T know and then introduce them. I think this would help tremendously to support networking in game.
title: Add a mutual friends indicator
